high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of an article from a news website. The content of the article discusses the Great Pacific Garbage Patch, which is described as a large accumulation of marine waste particles located in the central North Pacific Ocean. The text explains that the plastic in the patch originates from countries in Asia, North America, and South America, particularly from the Pacific Rim.
